title: HUD Sec Joins Austin's Homelessness Fight
summary:
*   A press conference was held to highlight Austin's efforts to end veteran homelessness.
*   U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Secretary Julian Castro participated in the event.
*   The discussion focused on the city's commitment to supporting its veteran community.
*   No policy decisions or actions were taken at this specific meeting.
